A.name: Stack A: 70x Real-Time Diarization & Search
A.tagline: Speaches & WhisperX ASR transcribe at 70x speed with word timestamps, MinIO stores raw audio, Meilisearch indexes every spoken word.

B.name: Stack B: Meeting Intelligence & Subtitle Studio
B.tagline: Scriberr & Whisper-WebUI generate diarized meeting summaries and SRT/VTT captions, Label Studio reviews audio turns, n8n routes action items.

speaches.name: Speaches (Faster-Whisper API)
speaches.role: OpenAI-compatible CTranslate2 Whisper speech-to-text server with word timestamps
speaches.first_run: Open Swagger UI at /docs or POST audio to /v1/audio/transcriptions (100% OpenAI SDK compatible).

whisperx-asr.name: WhisperX ASR Webservice
whisperx-asr.role: Turnkey REST ASR & diarization API with Swagger UI and SRT/VTT/JSON export
whisperx-asr.first_run: Open /docs to upload any MP3/WAV/MP4 and export word-aligned SRT, VTT, or JSON transcripts.

minio.name: MinIO Audio Vault
minio.role: S3-compatible sovereign object storage for raw call recordings & transcripts
minio.first_run: Log in with minioadmin and MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD from tools/minio/.env; create bucket 'audio-inbox'.

meilisearch.name: Meilisearch Transcripts
meilisearch.role: Sub-50ms full-text search engine across thousands of diarized transcripts
meilisearch.first_run: Use MEILI_MASTER_KEY from tools/meilisearch/.env to search spoken phrases & speaker turns instantly.

scriberr.name: Scriberr Meeting Studio
scriberr.role: Self-hosted AI audio transcription, speaker diarization & meeting summary app
scriberr.first_run: Upload podcasts or sales calls directly in the web UI for diarized transcripts & AI summaries.

whisper-webui.name: Whisper-WebUI Studio
whisper-webui.role: Visual Gradio subtitle studio for local audio, video & YouTube SRT/VTT captions
whisper-webui.first_run: Drag-and-drop video/audio files or paste YouTube URLs to export synced SRT/VTT/LRC captions.

label-studio.name: Label Studio Audio QA
label-studio.role: Interactive audio waveform review, speaker-turn QA & fine-tuning annotation UI
label-studio.first_run: Create your local account on first visit and select the 'Audio Transcription & Diarization' template.

n8n-speech.name: n8n Speech Automator
n8n-speech.role: Auto-watch MinIO audio uploads -> transcribe -> index in Meilisearch -> CRM
n8n-speech.first_run: Import /automations/stack_a_audio_to_search_index.n8n.json to automate end-to-end call processing.
